versions.content: The RTE Generator and the RTE Implementation Plug-In shall consider all VariableDataPrototype instances in PortPrototype s of Atomic Software Component s which are connected to VariableDataProto- type instances in PortPrototype s of the NvBlockSwComponent which in turn are mapped together with the same NvBlockDataMapping to an element of the ram- Block as belonging to the same Data Communication Graph . Additionally the mapped element of the ramBlock belongs to this Data Communication Graph .
